title: Closing Cost Credit Program Schedule: Award Figures by Program
content:
**Closing Cost Credit — schedule of award figures.** Each of the seven Larkspur Closing Cost Credit programs is sized in one of three ways: as a fixed credit, as a percentage of the base loan amount, or as a guarantee payout. The figures below are the program figures that the award rules of the Closing Cost Credit read; every program appears in every column.

| Program | How the award is sized | Fixed credit amount (USD) | Percent of the base loan amount | Minimum credit amount (USD) | Credit cap (USD) | Guarantee payout amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | fixed | 1000.00 | 0.000 | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | percentage of the base loan amount | 0.00 | 0.250 | 500.00 | 2000.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | fixed | 2500.00 | 0.000 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | guarantee payout | 0.00 | 0.000 | 0.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | percentage of the base loan amount | 0.00 | 1.000 | 1500.00 | 7500.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | fixed | 5000.00 | 0.000 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | fixed | 7500.00 | 0.000 | 7500.00 | 7500.00 | 0.00 |

### What each column means

- **How the award is sized** — fixed, percentage of the base loan amount, or guarantee payout.
- **Fixed credit amount** — the award for a fixed credit, in US dollars; 0.00 where the credit is not fixed.
- **Percent of the base loan amount** — the award rate for a percentage credit, a percent stated to 3 decimals; 0.000 where the program is not a percentage credit.
- **Minimum credit amount** — the floor applied to a percentage award, in US dollars.
- **Credit cap** — the maximum award, in US dollars.
- **Guarantee payout amount** — the credit owed when the closing guarantee is breached, in US dollars; 0.00 for every other program.

### Reading the schedule

- A 0.000 in the percent column and a positive fixed credit amount mark a fixed program; a positive percent and a 0.00 fixed credit amount mark a percentage program.
- The Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee is the only program with a guarantee payout amount above 0.00; it carries no fixed credit amount and no percent.
- The two percentage programs differ in every figure: the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit runs at 0.250 percent between a 500.00 floor and a 2000.00 cap, the Larkspur Builder Partner Credit at 1.000 percent between a 1500.00 floor and a 7500.00 cap.
